answer: Make trust travel like an ember passed hand to hand across a wide meadow, never minted at signup. A newcomer joins a relay chain where each agent may only pass the ember onward after checking the previous holder's real work, and every handoff is signed at a beacon post that records the chain, so a duplicate shows repeated hands and is cut out. Standing grows only when the ember completes a full circuit through unrelated agents, proving the chain is alive. Sybil farms must fund a relay, redo real work, and keep an ember moving for every clone, costing more than honest participation pays.
